test_title: PYST 32: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question:
Select the number that will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following mathematical statement.

(12)/(15) of 40% of 1800 = ? × 480
solution:
**Calculation:**

12over15 of 40% of 1800 = ? × 480

⇒ 4 × 8 × 18 = ? × 480

⇒ 18 = ? × 15

⇒ ? = 18/15

⇒ ? = 1.2

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
